limits: A is a conditional edited reading, not a uniquely solved cryptogram. Its extra visible mark, exclusion interpretation,15 substitutions and6 fills are separate components of the price.
A's edited body retains the original unit suffix1P as AOK1P (raw AVK1P), while its footer reads AOK11. The p179 thematic parallel is not used to silently normalize the body unit field.

B2 and C1 have matching printed20.05(13/11) references, complementary part numbers and compatible provisions content. They are likely companions; no unique source-history or exact original assembly is proved.
B2 retains its jammed-to-end note even though the counted176 slots equal its label. No unprinted tail is restored.
B2 keeps LAENGSTENSOCH and FELDINTENTENDANT, without adding the missing-looking N or deleting a duplicated-looking syllable.
C1 keeps the unknown dispatch interval, portion quantity and headquarters label; EFXGF remains a literal noncoordinate E mask. No numerical or Q-cell assignment is inferred.
All printed dates and times remain independent source labels, including20.00 p.m. and the03.32/03.45 p.m. intercepts. No chronology is corrected by plausibility.
